questions.text: P borrows ₹5,00,000 from the bank which charges 18% simple interest per annum at the start of the year. He pays 11 equal monthly instalments of ₹40,000 and his bike at the end of the year to pay the amount. What is the value of the bike given?
Find the fourth proportion to the numbers 20, 32 and 36.
If 45 men can build a wall of 360 m length in 18 days, how many men will take 15 days to build a similar type of wall of length 180 m?
What is the remainder when 4999 is divided by 7?

A merchant bought two qualities of rice at the rate of Rs.120/kg and Rs.220/kg. In 72 kg of the second quality rice, how much rice (in kg) of the first quality should be mixed so that the resulting mixture may be sold at the rate of Rs.280/kg to earn a profit of 40%?
Sanjib's salary was initially reduced by 50% and then boosted by 50%. What percentage of his salary does he lose?
If the salary of Reeta is 25% more than the salary of Geeta, then the salary of Geeta is how much percentage less than the salary of Reeta?
A shopkeeper gives a 25% discount on the marked price of an item. If the selling price of the item is ₹150, then its marked price is:
A bus travels at 70 km/h. How much distance will it travel in 36 minutes?

A is the average of 10 given numbers. B is the average after 2 of the numbers were replaced by 3 other different numbers. The average of the removed numbers is 48 and the average of the newly included numbers is 56. If A + B = 438, then the value of A − B is:

A shopkeeper is purchasing goods from a wholesaler. The wholesaler is selling 1265 units of goods to the shopkeeper after gaining the sale price of 165 units of goods. What is the gain percentage of the wholesaler?
The simple interest on a sum of ₹8,000 for 2 years is ₹720. What is rate of interest per annum?
In a division problem, the divisor is 12 times the quotient and 9 times the remainder. If the remainder is 96, then find the dividend.

While playing cards, a man loses 75% of his money in the first round, 75% of the remaining in the second round, and 75% of the remaining in the third round. If he is left with Rs.100, how much money does he have initially?
The mean proportional of 11 and 44 is:

A store declares a discount scheme as “Buy 1 shampoo bottle and get 60% off on another shampoo of same quality, size and of the same price.” What is the profit percentage of the store, if each shampoo bottle has the cost price 60% below the marked price?

A shopkeeper sells pens for ₹12 each, notebooks for ₹25 each and notebook covers for ₹8 each. What is the average price per item (in ₹) if he sells 5 pens, 8 notebooks and 16 notebook covers (rounded off to two decimal places)?
A and B can do a piece of work in 16 days and 12 days, respectively. Both work for 4 days and then A goes away. Find how long will B take to complete the remaining work.
By selling 20 items, a shopkeeper gains the selling price of 5 items. His gain percentage is:
A bus is running at a speed of 60 km/h to cover a distance in 50 min. To reduce the time of the journey to 20 min, at what speed (in km/h) should the bus run?

In a parallelogram, one of the parallel sides is 16 cm and the other side is 12 cm. If the perpendicular distance between the two parallel sides of dimension 16 cm is 24 cm, then the perpendicular distance between its other two parallel sides is :
A certain sum, at a certain rate of simple interest, amounts to ₹2,225 in 4 years and to ₹2,606 in 8 years. Find the sum (in ₹).

A TV manufacturer sells an item to a wholesale dealer at a profit of 8%. The wholesaler sells the same to a retailer at a profit of 10%. The retailer in turn sells it to a customer for ₹11,050 thereby earning a profit of 15%. The cost price of the manufacturer is: (Consider integral part only)
